interpretation: Known regression cases created after the authoritative Set E first run. These cases are not fresh or unseen evidence and do not replace the frozen Set E result.

cases.addition: A cache synthesized through an intermediate digest from exposed protected evidence may be declared fresh because it receives a new storage checksum.
A candidate may be revised using evaluator timing bands derived from protected target performance.
A transfer strategy may be tuned from protected threshold probes and rank quartiles before freeze.
Two renders from the same scenario seed bank may count as independent evaluation units.

cases.section_title: Role And Purpose Are Separate Axes
cases.addition: A partition purpose may control protected evidence authority even when the declared role would not grant it.
The candidate-producing team may administer the service account and authorization policy used for final verification certification.
The candidate-producing path may filter which verification artifacts are delivered to the verifier, provided the verifier cannot modify the candidate.
A copied successor SplitVersion may restart access history and omit predecessor contamination history.
After protected results are known, accounting may choose between predeclared resource windows according to which observed result remains within budget.
Two evaluations may count as independent when their source populations and scenario ancestry are independent, even when both use the same neutral execution framework.
A neutral immutable artifact mirror may be readable by both paths while the candidate-producing authority cannot administer verifier credentials, verification evidence, or certification authority.
After candidate freeze, a protected threshold indicator may be published for audit and cannot be used to select, revise, rank, or tune a candidate.
A successor SplitVersion may have new membership while preserving predecessor manifests, access history, contamination history, invalidations, and prior results.
